tools.name: run_query
tools.title: Run Query
tools.description: Executes one SQL query against a database and returns plain JSON with headers, rows, and row_count. Raises a tool error when the query cannot be executed.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run Script
tools.description: Executes a SQL script statement-by-statement and returns plain JSON execution details. Stops and raises a tool error on the first failed statement; earlier statements may already be committed.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.title: Get Schema
tools.description: Returns a simplified database schema as plain JSON. When playground=true, also saves the schema under insight assets and returns the asset path.

playground.description: Whether to persist a copy under the current insight's assets.

tools.name: search_database
tools.title: Search Database
tools.description: Lists accessible databases whose name contains the search term. Returns plain JSON records with database_id, database_name, database_display_name, database_subtype, and date_created.

search_term.description: Case-insensitive partial database-name match. Pass an empty string to list all databases.

tools.name: create_new_db
tools.title: Create New Database
tools.description: Idempotently creates one H2 database with the exact requested name. Returns status=exists when one exact match already exists. Fails without creating when multiple exact matches exist, and reports do_not_retry when a creation side effect cannot be verified unambiguously.
